session.zh: 跨市场收盘 · 美国 / 香港 9 月 10 日
session.en: Cross-market close · US / Hong Kong Sep 10

headline.zh: 油价与长端利率再上台阶，跨市场风险资产连续承压；存储现货交易维持低迷。
headline.en: Oil and long yields stepped higher, extending cross-market pressure on risk assets; memory spot trading remained subdued.

summary.zh: 截至上海时间 9 月 11 日早晨，美国与香港最近完整交易日均为 9 月 10 日。标普 500 下跌 0.6% 至 7,591.70，纳指下跌 0.7% 至 26,081.72；恒指下跌 320 点（1.3%）至 24,954，恒生科技指数下跌 2.0%。AP 报道布伦特原油收于每桶 107.63 美元、日内一度超过 108 美元，10 年期美债收益率升至 4.95%。TrendForce 当日现货页显示 DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 均价为 45.279 美元、日跌 0.09%，DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 均价日跌 0.31%；这是一日现货观察，不足以推断行业利润或周期反转。
summary.en: As of the morning of September 11 in Shanghai, September 10 was the latest completed session in both the US and Hong Kong. The S&P 500 fell 0.6% to 7,591.70 and the Nasdaq 0.7% to 26,081.72; the Hang Seng lost 320 points (1.3%) to 24,954 and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 2.0%. AP reported Brent settled at $107.63 per barrel after briefly topping $108, while the 10-year Treasury yield rose to 4.95%. TrendForce's same-day spot page showed DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 at $45.279, down 0.09% on the day, and DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 down 0.31%; this is a one-day spot observation, not evidence for industry profits or a cycle turn.

title.zh: 能源驱动的通胀不确定性正在压缩风险偏好。
title.en: Energy-led inflation uncertainty is compressing risk appetite.

detail.zh: 连续第四个交易日的美国股市下跌与香港科技股走弱，发生在油价和美国长端利率共同上行的背景下。把这一组合视为估值压力是分析判断；它不构成对联储决定、公司盈利或市场底部的预测。
detail.en: A fourth consecutive US down day and weaker Hong Kong technology shares coincided with higher oil and US long yields. Treating that combination as a valuation headwind is analysis, not a forecast of a Federal Reserve decision, company earnings, or a market bottom.

label.zh: 美国 10 年期国债收益率 · Sep 10

title.zh: 原油和长端利率进一步收紧估值环境
title.en: Oil and long yields further tighten the valuation backdrop

detail.zh: AP 报道布伦特原油上涨 6.3% 至每桶 107.63 美元，10 年期美债收益率从前一日收盘的 4.83% 升至 4.95%。这抬高了高估值资产的折现率敏感性，但并不单独决定货币政策。
detail.en: AP reported Brent rose 6.3% to $107.63 per barrel and the 10-year Treasury yield climbed to 4.95% from 4.83% late Wednesday. That raises the discount-rate sensitivity of premium assets, but does not by itself determine monetary policy.

detail.zh: RTHK 报道恒指收于 24,954，恒生科技指数下跌 90 点或 2.0% 至 4,330。腾讯当日下跌 1.9% 至 425.60 港元（ET Net）；指数和单日股价变动均不构成长期经营逻辑变化。
detail.en: RTHK reported the Hang Seng closed at 24,954 and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 90 points, or 2.0%, to 4,330. ET Net reported Tencent fell 1.9% to HK$425.60; neither index nor one-day share-price moves change a long-term operating thesis.

title.zh: 折叠 iPhone 的需求估计仍属外部预测
title.en: Foldable-iPhone demand estimate remains an external forecast

detail.zh: TrendForce 估计 Apple 的 iPhone Duo 在 2026 年出货约 500 万部、占折叠屏手机市场 24.8%。这是行业机构估计，并非 Apple 指引或实际销售；应以预订、发售后供给和公司披露验证。
detail.en: TrendForce estimates Apple's iPhone Duo could ship about 5 million units in 2026 and take 24.8% of the foldable-smartphone market. This is an industry estimate, not Apple guidance or actual sales; validate it with preorders, post-launch supply and company disclosures.

title.zh: 存储现货市场保持清淡并出现小幅下修
title.en: Memory spot market stays quiet with modest downward revisions

detail.zh: TrendForce 表示部分 DDR5 报价开始小幅下修、买方询价有限；其价格页显示 DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 日跌 0.09%，DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 日跌 0.31%。将日度现货变动外推为合约价或 HBM 盈利趋势并不可靠。
detail.en: TrendForce said selected DDR5 quotes began modest downward revisions and buyer inquiries were limited; its price page showed DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 down 0.09% and DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 down 0.31% on the day. Extrapolating daily spot moves to contract pricing or HBM profitability is not reliable.
